title: Eventual identity and cocycle for specified lifted transitions
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram of Noetherian rings, c a limit cone of Spec(R) with affine vertex S, and f:X_i→Spec(R_i) a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. For j≥i write X_j=X_i×Spec(R_j) and X=X_i×S [def-pc-base-change]. Fix a finite affine open cover U of X_j and finitely presented quasi-coherent modules N_a on its members [pqf-def-coherent]. Let M be any module on X. Suppose k≥j and natural overlap transitions T on U×X_k [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions] are supplied, together with isomorphisms of their local objects to the pullbacks of N_a and an invertible component comparison of their limit pullback to the restriction descent data of M. Then at some l≥k the specific canonical pullback T' of T to U×X_l is coherent: it satisfies the identity and triple composition equations on all test schemes. The refinement chart map defining T' is the pullback lift over X_l→X_k, and not a fresh choice of transitions. The limit pullback of T' still admits an invertible component comparison to the restriction descent data of M.

proof.text: Choose a supplied limit comparison ε. Comparison.coherent proves coherence of the limit raw transitions. Apply eventual chart equations to obtain l, chosen pairwise and threefold pullbacks, and the diagonal and universal triple equations for the prescribed T′.

The proved coherent_of_universal_tests pulls the diagonal identity along any chart map. On arbitrary triples, lift the three maps to the chosen threefold pullback and pull its composition equation along that lift. PullHom preserves identities and composition by cancellation of its pseudofunctor comparisons. Thus T′ is coherent on all test schemes.

Prove overlapLimitMap_stage_comp from cone naturality and baseChangeMap_comp. Apply nonempty_overlap_comparison_refinement with the displayed canonical refinement maps to preserve the original limit comparison. Combine this comparison with the coherence just proved.

theorem exists_finitePresentation_overlap_eventual_coherence
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt]
    (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (U : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).OpenCover.{u})
    [Finite U.I₀] [∀ a, IsAffine (U.X a)]
    (N : (a : U.I₀) → (U.X a).Modules)
    (hN : ∀ a, (N a).IsFinitePresentation) (hNq : ∀ a, (N a).IsQuasicoherent)
    (M : (pullback f (c.π.app (op i))).Modules) :
    ∀ (k : I) (hjk : j ≤ k),
      let q₀ := overlapStageMap R f hij hjk
      let V₀ : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjk))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
        U.pullback₁ q₀
      let p₀ := overlapLimitMap R c f (hij.trans hjk)
      ∀ T : modulesPseudofunctor.OverlapTransitions V₀.f,
        (∀ a, Nonempty ((T.obj a : (V₀.X a).Modules) ≅
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U.pullbackHom q₀ a)).obj (N a))) →
        Nonempty ((T.pull (p := p₀) (α := fun a ↦ a)
          (fun a ↦ V₀.pullbackHom_map p₀ a)).Comparison
          ((modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData (V₀.pullback₁ p₀).f).obj M)) →
        ∃ (l : I) (hkl : k ≤ l),
          let q := overlapStageMap R f hij (hjk.trans hkl)
          let V : (pullback f (Spec.map
              (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans (hjk.trans hkl)))))).OpenCover.{u} :=
            U.pullback₁ q
          let r := overlapStageMap R f (hij.trans hjk) hkl
          let s := overlapRefinementHom U q₀ q r
            (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkl)
          let T' := T.pull (p := r) (α := fun a ↦ a) (p' := s)
            (fun a ↦ overlapRefinementHom_map U q₀ q r
              (overlapStageMap_comp R f hij hjk hkl) a)
          let p := overlapLimitMap R c f (hij.trans (hjk.trans hkl))
          T'.Coherent ∧
            Nonempty ((T'.pull (p := p) (α := fun a ↦ a)
              (fun a ↦ V.pullbackHom_map p a)).Comparison
              ((modulesPseudofunctor.toDescentData (V.pullback₁ p).f).obj M))
